content.text: The Braves look to clinch a series sweep on Sunday afternoon when they host the Royals The Atlanta Braves look to stay unbeaten on the season when they play the Kansas City Royals on Sunday afternoon. They won the season-opener by shutout, but needed some late-game heroics to win the second game on Saturday. The Braves trailed the Royals 2-0 heading into the bottom of the ninth, but they would score six times to get the walk-off victory. Dominic Smith hit a grand slam to win the game, and it sent the Braves to a second straight victory. Sunday, they will now look to pick up the series sweep when they send Grant Holmes to the mound to start. Holmes is in his third season with the Braves. He made 21 starts in 2025 and went 4-9 with a 3.99 ERA.
